# Private Hire

## Private hire

Both of our Electric Cinema venues can be hired individually for private events. Please click below for full details and technical specifications.

### Electric Portobello

The Electric Portobello is a unique space which lends itself to a range of opportunities for private hire for up to a maximum of 83 people. If you need a day venue for a press launch, screening, presentation or conference, we have the ideal space, technology, food, drink and service to make it happen.

Please email our private hire team below for evening hire.  
privateevents.westlondon@sohohouse.com

[Seat plan](https://www.electriccinema.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Electric-Portobello-Screen-1.png)

[Technical specs](https://www.electriccinema.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Cinema-Tech-Specs-Electric-Portobello-Jan-2026.pdf)

![](https://www.electriccinema.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/From-seats.jpg)

### Electric White City

Electric Cinema White City is a available for private hire for up to a maximum of 116 people across all 3 screens, as well as a large lobby space for a post or pre-screening reception. Our three screening rooms offer 4K laser projection, Dolby Atmos sound and XpanD 3D, and can accommodate 4K alternative content.

If you need a day venue for a press launch, screening, presentation or conference, we have the ideal space, technology, food, drink and service to make it happen.

For more information or enquiries please email our events team below.  
privateevents.westlondon@sohohouse.com

[Seat plans](https://www.electriccinema.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/WCH-seatmaps-2025.pdf)

[Technical specs](https://www.electriccinema.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Cinema-Tech-Specs-Electric-White-City-a.pdf)

![](https://www.electriccinema.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/5DM46195-scaled.jpg)
